notes.title: Post Release thoughts + Future! Thank you!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078151/9876a84a584bfda413638fe4c7c677e0bf749251.png[/img]
Now that I've had a chance to really digest the hectic release, reception, bugfixes and so on... Thank you all so much for the warm reception and even [b]INTENSE[/b] enjoyment of Bat to the Heavens... I know some people have already started speedrunning and going absolutely wacky modo in finding the secrets!!! Wow... that already makes me happy... That already speaks volumes on how much you enjoy the game alone!! I can't thank you enough!

(The game is still on release sale until [b]Dec 22nd![/b] Tell all your friends!! Bat them)

I'm honestly still just surprised and happy that just making a game as difficult and different from a lot of other games worked as well as it did! I did very strongly believe in it, but working for months alone builds up so much doubt in your heart. Like... sleepless nights. So much stress. I know it definitely isn't to everyone's taste, but despite that... Thank you all for making my hard work worth it and enjoying the game so much!!


[h2][b]Soundtrack![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078151/cf9ec970d6636d9b3e79e198a738f46a075006ff.png[/img]
Speaking of stuff that I worked hard on, I released the soundtrack on friday following the release unfortunately, but its out HERE and NOW!! And on [url=https://ceroro.bandcamp.com/album/bat-to-the-heavens-soundtrack]bandcamp[/url] ( if you want flacs or want to throw more support my way)! It is also on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8-4mwkVDKJQ&list=PL5xscnydcnh-LwA5o8LGgqlwaJO4mo6Oe]youtube[/url] for free! Shoutouts to ashwee for helping with a few of the tracks!
[i]Spoiler warning to the music if you care![/i]

[h2]mini retrospective on the launch[/h2]
Its already been [b]10[/b] days since the game came out, and while I do think I might have released during an exceptionally crowded time, the reception to the game is still AMAZING despite that! I hope that you can all continue enjoying Bat to the Heavens in whatever way you enjoy!

I don't know why I still feel stressed out despite launch going pretty well for my first game ever, but hopefully that can fade when I stop babying the game with all these patches! Since this game was conceived and made entirely within this year, a few bugs are expected, I think I've done well enough. I did talk about the game ( spoiler warning ) on a stream, and probably will continue to talk about it from time to time, but I'll only reveal more of my hand maybe like... a year down the line if the chance shows itself!

There are only a few more things left to really do and consider, which are:

[h3]On the mind![/h3]
[b]The Mac build[/b]... I am rethinking this, and without a reliable way to test it, I feel like it would be irresponsible of me to release on just because I could export it to mac. If I did that and it just didn't work I think it would be very irresponsible, so please hold out! ( The radeon gpu shader bug that happened was very stressful I don't wish to go through that again! )

[b]Community Items[/b], Making all those assets for trading cards and whatnot... I don't really dabble in these at all myself but I am working on them, expect them soon!

[b]Localization[/b]... Honestly, this one might be the biggest headache. I really have no idea if there is a way to do this more easily considering how most of the code is pretty badly written and non flexible!! Its hard for me to consider doing this immediately unless more interest in the game shows up, since dialogue is secondary in this game.

[h3]What else is planned?[/h3]
For the future, I want to make way more different, unique, interesting games! I'm overflowing with all sorts of ideas, just pray they don't get too big in scope like this one... ( they will )

[h3]Next game![/h3]
The next game I have planned is literally nothing like this one--the only thing that would be consistent is that everything happens in the same world! There is a small thing in game that does allude to what I want to make next, and hopefully I can spin it as well or better than bat to the heavens! I don't intend on being AS secret as I did this game, since it's not of a world explore-y nature, but I think it'll be interesting nonetheless!

I know that people have been lamenting finishing bat to the heavens game cause of running out of content... the entropy of games running out for players to consume and enjoy... So...

[h3]Would I add extra content?[/h3]
I would consider it if the fancy strikes me, and if the game does well! But at the moment, I really don't have any large desire to. I might have burnt myself a little out on this game, especially in the final weeks. It'll be hard to justify adding more stuff if it remains niche, especially since I did my best to fit as much content I could into the game. I would also have to worry about further optimization if more content is added. I'll never say never though!

Wowzor! That was a handful. Thank you so much for enjoying the game thus far! I can't believe I've released a game.. now that's wacky. I hope you look forward to what I make and do next!

notes.title: Bat to the Heavens is OUT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078151/b8b1b457a1a0ab4439e62f17df03c767143d7414.gif[/img]

Wow! the game is out! Tell all your friends!

[h2]wow.[/h2]
wow... the game is out... that's crazy. Launch is so stressful and it still is stressful! Development won't be over for awhile still!! But we're here and we're DOING THIS!!

Thank you all for all the support kind words, sharing, EVERYTHING honestly. People who look for bugs, draw fanart, and play a lot or even simply enjoying the game! This game is unlike anything else I've seen but I'm glad to know it worked out in the end despite only having a handful of playtesters! ( shoutouts to the playtesters!! ) who shall be the first to beat the game, find [i]THAT[/i] secret, or all the secrets??

I look forward to fully finishing the game and all its issues and make sure everything is optimal! I hope you too look forward to it!!

To come is to fix those minor bugs ( and some major ones that are probably still being found as we speak) , Eventually I'll release a mac build when all those bugs are ironed out, and hopefully keep up support for as long as possible! I do have my next idea brewing in mind but launch day was so hectic, I'll have to get myself more organized before then!

Next post, I'll probably talk more about my mindset of the game and a retrospective of launch week,

Thank you for playing my game! It was a tiny idea that was supposed to be a small game but if I didn't take this idea to as far as I could I would regret it. Without your support this definitely would not have been possible or done as well as I could have. LOVE YOU ALL!!!

notes.title: Release! December 9th! [ 9 / 12 / 2024 ]
notes.content:
[h1]The game is available, December 9th!!!!!!![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078151/7cfb2e7d59472d388f4d4dea676f1ce67a59b8c6.png[/img]

[h1]The game is available, December 9th!!!!!!![/h1]

I already revealed the release date prior on other social media and on the steam page, but might as well make an official announcement on Steam! Only 7 ish days until release!

[h3]announcement![/h3]
Games out soon! I was gonna make a trailer for it, but making sure the game is in it's best state before release is more important. ( endless testing, balance, fixes, polish, and adjustments ) I also don't want to spoil any more puzzle solutions or secrets at all. I'm very stubborn about this, I don't want to rob anyone's first time experiences! I thought I was ready for release, but I don't know so much anymore now that I set the date! I don't think I'd EVER be ready for release though, no matter what the circumstances were.

[h3]some thoughts and moving forward[/h3]
Its crazy to think that this is my first game and it's finally coming out!! Developing this game took 95% of my focus this year, so its an understatement to say I'm extremely nervous... I have a lot of thoughts to say after release and I totally want to take a break after it comes out, but I know that all the issues will come flooding in once people start playing this!! So don't break it too bad... ( or do, we gotta fix those nasty bugs )

I'll be ready to fix everything that gets reported so please [b]report bugs and issues in forum or email asap![/b]

My gaming brain still keeps wanting to add content but its time to stop!!!

notes.title: progress progress
notes.content:
ceroro here yes

this is an update, but more of a ramble. Thats your warning!

Its already been 4 months since I put the game page on steam, 8 months since I started! I have been steadily working on finishing it ASAP! I am pretty tired of working nonstop on bat to the heavens for months and months straight, I'm going a lil crazy! ( I do think you have to be a lil crazy to do solo gamedev regardless...)

Here are some of the things that have happened and are left to be done!

[h2]PROGRESS!![/h2]
[list]
[*] progress is about like... 95% done, seriously!
[*] Mainly some music, sprites, and art to be done but the base is pretty much there!
[*] all levels done, puzzles tested, fixed, cheese prevention!!!
[*] so many sound effects. so many.
[*] We finally have our first completion from playtesters! ( game is hard , ending was in only recently!)
[*] Tons and tons of secrets have been put in the game... will anyone find them all? ( will anyone bother?)
[*] Some polish and refining to be done...
[*] File cleanup as well, and maybe final optimizations...
[*] lots of stress accumulation on release timing... 
[*] my brain is thinking of next game idea... stop it brain
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078151/beec269aa9a81a3042d872a0ea3102e25ca04dd0.png[/img]
yaaay ( npc reveal )

[h2]RAMBLING!![/h2]
Making a game is so stressful cause of how much work and effort I put into it before releasing, and I still have to worry about marketing, which I really don't want to do any, honestly!! I want to let the game speak for itself!! Its a hard game so I'm also worried that will scare off people or give a bad impression... But I'll stick true to the core design and make sure its hard and rewarding!! ( maybe its cause ive been playing it for so long!! )

At this point, I better just stop worrying and just finish and release it and not think about it any further!! (except for bugfixes)

Now that my brain is like half thinking of next game though, scope and content creep SHOULD stop ( but it prob won't ).
When you put one new thing, you gotta consider sounds for it, art for it, maybe music, maybe unique interactions, anything the player could think of... It becomes a headache later on very quickly!!

But I'd say the more content a game has the more people can enjoy it (even if they might never see it)!!
[i]Honestly I still can't estimate the playtime, and don't want to give false estimates, but, its a lot longer than I had intended![/i]
I'm excited... and scared to see people play my game!!

[h2]wrapup[/h2]
This has truly been a cerothoughts(tm) blogpost instead of a #professionalgamedevupdate, but hopefully once the last few things are done I can set a release date!! I want to aim for before the end of this year, and if I keep working hard and don't be stuck with perfectionism, it should happen. Hype!!

for my next game I'm definitely taking it easier!!

notes.title: its here!!
notes.content:
hello this is ceroro!!!

I'm not sure what to say since its a first time thing, But here it is! The game I started this year and have been working on nonstop!! [b]BAT TO THE HEAVENS[/b]!!! 

I wanna keep big official updates here so people who wishlist it can keep track and follow! Inform people along the way! I may create a discord later, but I'll think about that more as release comes closer.

Since I'm reallly focused on working on the game, I'll probably only post every so often until release, but, keep your eyes peeled! Solo dev is hectic!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078151/e1f7fb0ebb02e21c66f8d3f9e5cdea2c3d1324db.gif[/img]
[h1]A little tidbit[/h1]
So I don't really want to spoil too much about the game, because it is a [b]PUZZLE and EXECUTION[/b] game!!

What does that mean? You'll have to solve obstacles as they come and they won't be easy! Then, you'll have to actually be able to clear them with the techniques and tricks you learn along the way!

I really wanted to follow that to the best of my abilities, challenging myself to make creative puzzles and level design... when I think that is probably my weakest point! Something straightforward in terms of progress, but also filled with stuff I always wanted to put in a game!

Either way, levels and mechanics, came first! Hopefully there is much joy found in mastering the ways of the BAT!

Things will start as simple as they come, but I think the learning curve might be a bit steeper than your average game. Deceptively simple is sorta the name of the game. Devil in the details. Whatever. But as a result everything is more satisfying to solve and hopefully not too frustrating!

--

This originally was supposed to be a super small simple project that literally started from a document with only 4 words in it, but the idea was fun and lead to some very clever puzzles. Added more and more, ideas kept coming, and... here we are today!

I do want to release this sooner than later, but I want to make sure it is a complete experience before that happens.

thank you very much for reading!!!
